name: Cochlear Limited
summary: Cochlear Limited provides implantable hearing solutions in the Americas, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and Asia Pacific. It offers cochlear implant systems; replacement sound processors, accessories, and other services; bone conduction systems and replacement sound processors; and recipient support tools. The company also provides Cochlear connected care solutions, such as Cochlear Nucleus SmartNav System; Cochlear Custom Sound Pro Fitting Software; Cochlear Remote Assist; Cochlear Remote Check; and Cochlear Link.
